verdict.rationale: vLLM ships a CLI that starts the OpenAI-compatible API server (vllm-docs-27, vllm-docs-9), and Docker-based deployment is documented (vllm-docs-26), implying standard process start/stop via normal OS/container mechanisms. However, there's no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'stop' command or graceful shutdown CLI flag, and no community evidence confirming stop/start workflow in practice. Missing for 10: explicit stop/shutdown command documentation, independent hands-on confirmation of start/stop lifecycle management.
